quote: The universe is made of stories, / not of atoms.
source: Muriel Rukeyser, The Speed of Darkness, section IX (Random House, 1968)

evidence.where: The text of the title poem as published by the Muriel Rukeyser estate site, read at section IX, which runs: Time comes into it. / Say it. Say it. / The universe is made of stories, / not of atoms. The two lines are the close of the section, lineated exactly as proposed, with the comma at the end of the first line and the full stop after atoms. The commonly circulated shortening to stories not atoms is not the poem’s wording and was not used.
evidence.edition: Muriel Rukeyser, The Speed of Darkness (Random House, 1968)
evidence.locator: the title poem, section IX, closing two lines

reason: Located in the named poem at the named section, in this wording and this lineation, ending in a full stop. Rukeyser is unbanned and stands at nought for the year, and nothing of hers is shipped elsewhere in First Light. It is a steadying thing to read early and needs no warning.
